file_insights.change_description: Added complete bandit security scanning configuration
key_additions: skips: 2 specific test codes (B308, B703) configured as false positives
severity: Set to MEDIUM level reporting

patterns_discovered.description: Configuration explicitly acknowledges Django-specific patterns that trigger false positives (mark_safe, safestring utilities)
patterns_discovered.relevance: Shows understanding of Django framework security considerations

patterns_discovered.description: Excludes test directories and build artifacts while maintaining security scanning on main codebase
patterns_discovered.relevance: Prevents test false positives while keeping production code scanned

patterns_discovered.description: Set severity to MEDIUM to focus on significant security issues rather than all warnings
patterns_discovered.relevance: Pragmatic approach to reduce noise from low-priority security concerns

gotchas_discovered.description: mark_safe (B308) and django.utils.safestring (B703) are intentional Django security utilities that bandit flags as concerns
gotchas_discovered.impact: Without proper skips configuration, legitimate Django security practices would be flagged as violations
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Explicitly skipped both test codes with clear comments explaining why

gotchas_discovered.description: Test code often uses less secure patterns for testing purposes that shouldn't block CI/CD
gotchas_discovered.impact: Security scanning test directories can produce high false positive rates
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Comprehensive exclude_dirs pattern matching for tests and migrations

approach_outcome.objective: Configure bandit security scanning tool in pyproject.toml
approach_outcome.completion_summary: Successfully added comprehensive bandit configuration with Django-aware exclusions and skip rules
approach_outcome.time_efficiency: Completed in single session without iterations

recommendations.recommendation: Document the B308 and B703 skips in project security guidelines
recommendations.rationale: Team members should understand why these Django utilities are intentionally excluded from bandit scanning

recommendations.recommendation: Periodically review skipped test codes as bandit and Django evolve
recommendations.rationale: Security concerns might change; periodic audit ensures skips remain justified

recommendations.recommendation: Consider lowering severity threshold to LOW in local development vs MEDIUM in CI/CD
recommendations.rationale: Local development can benefit from more warnings while CI/CD focuses on critical issues

recommendations.recommendation: Add bandit-specific .bandit file for more granular test exclusion if needed
recommendations.rationale: Current pyproject.toml approach is clean, but .bandit file offers additional customization
